stages.name: Foundation
stages.purpose: Authority, team rules, shared contracts and operational safety.

done_conditions.description: TEAM_RULES.md is the team authority.
Broadcast reads are verified through the latest comment.

stages.name: Portfolio / Data
stages.purpose: Maintain a reliable canonical portfolio and verified input data.

done_conditions.description: Canonical portfolio state exists.
Weekly SBI verification is operational.
Morning dataset completeness is fail-closed.

stages.name: Discovery
stages.purpose: Continuously identify what should be researched next.

done_conditions.description: Candidate Selector can generate research candidates.
Owner Picks remain explicit and protected.
Sector flow can be evaluated from market data.
Theme flow can be evaluated from explicit membership.
Candidates can be handed to Company Research without identity guessing.

stages.name: Research / Valuation
stages.purpose: Turn candidates into comparable company research and forward valuation scenarios.

done_conditions.description: Comparable canonical Company Research is operational.
Forward earnings and PER scenarios are operational.
Important facts can be traced to source evidence.

stages.name: Hypothesis
stages.purpose: Track whether investment hypotheses remain intact, strengthen or break.

done_conditions.description: Hypothesis lifecycle and evidence review are operational.
Material hypothesis checkpoints are represented as shared events.

stages.name: Investment Cockpit
stages.purpose: Show what needs attention now and what can safely be ignored.

done_conditions.description: Coverage state is projected without creating a new truth store.
Daily review items are prioritized and deduplicated.
Today / next 7d / next 30d material events are visible.

stages.name: Decision Memory
stages.purpose: Preserve decision-time reasoning without hindsight rewriting.

done_conditions.description: Decision snapshots and later reviews are operational.
Actual trades without journals can be detected.

stages.name: Learning Loop
stages.purpose: Learn from repeated decision-process patterns and counterexamples.

done_conditions.description: Decision patterns are evaluated with small-sample safeguards and counterexamples.
Actionable insights can return limited contextual questions to future decisions.
